blocks.text: The system follows a microservices architecture with event-driven communication between services. All services are containerized using Docker and orchestrated with Kubernetes.
The backend is built with Node.js 20 LTS using Express.js as the HTTP framework. The frontend uses React 18 with TypeScript. PostgreSQL 16 is the primary data store.
The authentication service handles user registration, login, token refresh, and session management. It uses JWT tokens with RS256 signing.
Access tokens expire after 15 minutes. Refresh tokens expire after 7 days. Both tokens are stored in HttpOnly secure cookies.
The document service manages file upload, storage, versioning, and retrieval. It interfaces with S3-compatible object storage.
The search service provides full-text search across all documents using Elasticsearch. It supports faceted search, autocomplete, and relevance tuning.
The PostgreSQL database uses a schema-per-tenant approach for multi-tenancy. Each tenant schema contains all application tables.
Redis is used for session storage, rate limiting, and application-level caching. Cache invalidation follows a write-through pattern.
